  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_ai_engine_git_mask_configs` does not match the valid top-level Git key `http.extraheader`, leaving its authorization header in the masked config mounted into the read-profile container.
  WHY: The regex requires a subsection between `http.` and `.extraheader`, which top-level keys lack; reviewers rated this from high to critical, and this uses the highest severity.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:267-272 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Duplicate key names from multi-valued Git config entries cause the unset loop to fail after the first `--unset-all` removes all values.
  WHY: A later unset returns exit code 5 and triggers `|| return 1`, aborting masking and falling back to Codex; reviewers rated this from low to critical, and this uses the highest severity.
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1275-1278 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The Codex binary preflight still prevents the security audit from reaching Claude when Claude is the resolved engine and Codex is unavailable.
  WHY: The preflight exits before Claude runs; the workflow also does not export `AI_ENGINE_RESOLVED_SECURITY_AUDIT`, so the conditional guards do not take effect in production; reviewers rated this from high to critical, and this uses the highest severity.
- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py: `test_security_audit_codex_preflight_only_on_fallback` | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The test manually sets `AI_ENGINE_RESOLVED_SECURITY_AUDIT=claude`, a variable the production workflow does not set, so it does not verify production behavior.
  WHY: The test can pass while the conditional preflight remains ineffective in production, and it does not verify the default unset/`codex` path.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:`_ai_engine_git_mask_configs` function, the regex pattern '^(http\..*\.extraheader|credential\.|url\..*\.insteadof|include\.|includeif\.|remote\..*\.(url|pushurl))' | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The regex does not match a top-level `http.extraheader` entry, leaving its authorization header in the masked configuration mounted into the read-profile container.
  WHY: The pattern requires a subsection between `http.` and `.extraheader`, so the model can read the token from the mounted config file.
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:`_ai_engine_git_mask_configs` function, the while IFS= read loop over keys_file calling git config --unset-all | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Duplicate key names for multi-valued Git config entries cause the unset loop to fail after the first `--unset-all` removes all instances.
  WHY: The second invocation returns exit code 5 and triggers `|| return 1`, causing isolation masking to fail and fall back to Codex.
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1273-1278 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `command -v codex` check remains unconditional when Claude is the resolved engine.
  WHY: If Codex is unavailable, the script exits before attempting Claude.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/security_audit.sh (LAST RUN DIFF, lines wrapping the Codex preflight) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The workflow does not set `AI_ENGINE_RESOLVED_SECURITY_AUDIT`, so the conditional guards around the Codex preflight default to `codex` and remain active in production.
  WHY: When Codex is unavailable, the unconditional preflight exits before the Claude path.
- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py (LAST RUN DIFF, `test_security_audit_codex_preflight_only_on_fallback`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The test manually sets `AI_ENGINE_RESOLVED_SECURITY_AUDIT=claude`, a variable the production workflow does not set.
  WHY: The test passes without establishing that the conditional preflight works in production and lacks a default-path test.
- Requirement: "Keep pool tokens outside the model process's filesystem and user identity; supply model authentication through a host-side relay and restrict model reads to non-secret audit inputs." (from issue #6236)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml`
  Evidence of absence: Neither the original PR diff nor the LAST RUN DIFF touches `security-audit.yml`. The workflow has no "Resolve AI engine" step, no `install-claude` action, no `claude-pool-token` action, and does not export `AI_ENGINE_RESOLVED_SECURITY_AUDIT`. The `security_audit.sh` script's conditional guards (LAST RUN DIFF) reference a variable the workflow never sets, making the Claude path unreachable in production. The original PR diff adds isolation to `scripts/ai_engine.sh`, but `security_audit.sh` calls Codex directly (line 1282: `if codex --ask-for-approval never ...`), not `claude_run`, so the isolation code is never exercised by the security audit.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
